# Project Deep Dive

[← Robinhood](../README.md) · [Every Robinhood question](../../robinhood.md) · [Read it on TrueInterview](https://trueinterview.io/study/project-deep-dive-3)

`deep-dive`

---

## Requirements

- Choose a single project and explore it thoroughly: describe the problem, your individual contribution, the architecture, and the central trade-offs you weighed (rationale, stakeholders, schedule).
- For Senior+ candidates, build 1–2 slides and optionally a diagram; you usually present for about 30 minutes, then handle in-depth follow-up questions.
- Come ready to argue the correctness guarantees of your design — for instance, how you ensured idempotency and data integrity, what obstacles and tensions surfaced, and how you worked through them.

## Notes

- This session shows up in almost every onsite loop and is taken very seriously; multiple candidates have cleared the coding and system design stages but failed here.
- The questioning drills deep into trade-offs and corner cases — interviewers press on the particulars of your choices, not just the story.

## Preparation

- Prepare one project end-to-end with a clean diagram and a trade-off matrix you can justify point by point.
- Script your answers ahead of time for correctness and idempotency, the toughest obstacle, and a disagreement you navigated.
